review.summary: The change adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID / services.discord.mention_id. Values are checked against a strict, anchored 17–20 digit pattern after trimming, and the resulting <@ID> mention is appended on its own line, with room reserved for it inside the 1800-character limit. Docs, .env.example, CHANGELOG and focused Pest tests covering valid, invalid, empty and truncation cases are all included. The implementation is lean, correct and in scope, so I would approve it as is.
